scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind connected devices and sensors.
Sensor: detects a change such as temperature or movement. Smart device: can use connected data to act.
Network: allows devices to exchange information. Automated irrigation: can water crops based on programmed rules. Security: protects connected devices and their information.
Design a simple paper model explaining sensor, smart device and network. Trade models with a classmate and explain how your design works.
